subject: Startups
title: Feature Adoption Rate
description: A quick, practical guide to Feature Adoption Rate.

hook.text: You built a new feature. Nobody uses it. Is it hidden, confusing, or just unnecessary? Feature adoption tells you.

buildup.text: Feature adoption rate is the percentage of active users who engage with a specific feature within a time period.

discovery.text: Instagram found that Stories had higher adoption than direct messages. That insight shaped their entire product roadmap.

twist.text: Low adoption doesn't always mean a bad feature. Sometimes it's great but buried. Discovery matters as much as design.

climax.text: Tracking adoption per feature tells you where to invest next—double down on what's loved, kill what's ignored.

punchline.text: Build less. Ship what users actually adopt.

quiz.question: What can low feature adoption indicate?
options: The feature may be unnecessary, hidden, or confusing
